QA Automation Intern

We are looking for a QA Automation Intern to join our Quality Engineering team for a 6-month
internship, with a possibility of full-time conversion.

Required Skills:
0-1 Years of experience (freshers welcome).
Basic knowledge of Selenium, TestNG, and Java.
Understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies.
BCA, BE, or B.Tech (final year or recent graduate).

Responsibilities:
Write and maintain automated test scripts.
Log and track bugs using JIRA.
Participate in daily standups and sprint planning.

Location: Chennai, Onsite
Employment Type: Internship
Notice Period: Immediate
Openings: 4
